# Teleco Ltd

> Ghana-based technology and engineering company delivering telecommunications infrastructure, software development, cybersecurity, automation, systems integration, and the Leslie AI assistant across West Africa.

Teleco Ltd is headquartered in Accra, Ghana. We design, build, and integrate mission-critical systems for enterprises, government, healthcare, telecom, retail, logistics, and hospitality.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Company story, mission, vision, and founder Emmanuel Nii Teiko Tagoe.
- [Services](/services): Telecom infrastructure, software development, automation, systems integration, R&D, cybersecurity.
- [Solutions](/solutions): Vertical solutions and platforms Teleco delivers.
- [Cybersecurity](/cybersecurity): Enterprise-grade managed SOC, penetration testing, incident response, compliance (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR, Ghana DPA).
- [Leslie AI](/leslie): Conversational AI assistant on WhatsApp and Telegram for shopping, payments, deliveries, and information.
- [Industries](/industries): Sectors we serve — healthcare, telecom, retail, logistics, public sector, education, hospitality.
